8.name: TEXT_CMNDEFSKYISLANDTOKENEXCHANGESHOP_00321_001
8.description: Forgive me, <hex:02080EE905FF056D697373FF0473697203>, but I deal only in sky pirate spoils, and you haven't got any.
8.translation_description: Perdonami, <hex:020817E905FF0A7369676E6F72696E61FF087369676E6F726503>, ma tratto solo cimeli dei pirati del cielo e tu non ne hai con te.

9.name: TEXT_CMNDEFSKYISLANDTOKENEXCHANGESHOP_00321_011
9.description: Terribly sorry, but unless you have sky pirate spoils, I'm afraid we cannot do business.
9.translation_description: Mi dispiace molto, ma senza cimeli dei pirati del cielo non possiamo fare affari.

10.name: TEXT_CMNDEFSKYISLANDTOKENEXCHANGESHOP_00321_021
10.description: Got spoils? 'Fraid I can't help you then, <hex:02080FE905FF056D697373FF056D61746503>.
10.translation_description: Hai dei cimeli? Allora temo di non poterti aiutare, <hex:020815E905FF0A7369676E6F72696E61FF06616D69636F03>.

11.name: TEXT_CMNDEFSKYISLANDTOKENEXCHANGESHOP_00321_031
11.description: We only accept a particular currency here, and that's sky pirate spoils. I gather you have none? Right, then.
11.translation_description: Qui accettiamo solo una valuta specifica: i cimeli dei pirati del cielo. Immagino tu non ne abbia, vero? Bene, allora.

12.name: TEXT_CMNDEFSKYISLANDTOKENEXCHANGESHOP_00321_041
12.description: If you come into possession of sky pirate spoils, I should be glad to trade with you.
12.translation_description: Se dovessi procurarti cimeli dei pirati del cielo, sarò lieto di fare affari con te.
